info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Equipment Maintenance Record Retrieval API
info.description: The Equipment Maintenance Record Retrieval API facilitates the access and retrieval of maintenance records for banking facilities' equipment. This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information about maintenance operations related to a specific piece of equipment. Typical consumers of this API include facility managers, maintenance personnel, and banking operations teams who need to ensure equipment reliability and compliance. By providing insights into past maintenance activities, this API supports informed decision-making and proactive equipment management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of the equipment maintenance operations for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Utilize this to view current maintenance activities and their statuses.
